name: Day-old chicks
title: Day-old chicks: broiler and layer strains
description: Vaccinated Ross 308 and Cobb 500 broiler chicks and Hy-Line and Lohmann Brown layer chicks from Masvingo, delivered with a brooding plan and 14 days of support.
summary: Broiler and layer chicks, vaccinated and graded for even weights.
alt: Day-old chicks crowding round a drinker on wood shavings.
lede: Chicks hatched, vaccinated and graded for uniformity, then delivered to your farm with a brooding plan written for Zimbabwean conditions.
intro: Every batch comes from a biosecure hatchery and travels in ventilated, sanitised chick boxes.

lists.heading: What comes with your chicks
items: A pre-delivery checklist covering litter, temperatures, drinkers and backup power.
A brooding starter pack with feed, vitamins and disinfectant.
Help on delivery day to record starting weights.
A record sheet for daily mortality, water and feed intake.

lists.heading: Broiler or layer?
lists.text: Broiler chicks are for meat; layer chicks grow into your laying flock. You can order either or both. If you’re not sure which strain suits your farm, pick ‘Not sure’ on the order form and tell us about your setup.

name: Broilers
title: Broilers: growers and finishers
description: Broiler growers and finishers from Masvingo, delivered at 3–6 weeks old with feed bundles, on-farm weighing and veterinary support.
summary: Growers and finishers for meat production, delivered at 3–6 weeks.
alt: White broiler chickens in an open-sided poultry house with rows of red feeders.
lede: Broilers bred for even growth and good feed conversion, so your batch reaches market weight together.
intro: We manage feed, health and housing from the breeder flock to your farm gate. Each delivery comes with production benchmarks so you can track your batch week by week.

lists.heading: What we offer
items: Growers and finishers delivered from 3 to 6 weeks old.
Contract growing for abattoirs and retailers.
Feed and medication bundles priced for the full cycle.
On-farm weighing and grading.
Vet call-outs for diagnosis and treatment.

lists.heading: Selling your birds
lists.text: We help line up your finish date with abattoir slots, wholesale buyers and cold storage, so birds leave your farm at the right weight. If you’d rather raise birds from the start, see our day-old broiler chicks.

name: Layers
title: Layers: pullets and point-of-lay hens
description: Layer pullets and point-of-lay hens from Masvingo with full vaccination records, feed phase charts and lighting programmes.
summary: Pullets and point-of-lay hens with full vaccination records.
alt: A brown laying hen with a red comb, close up.
lede: Pullets and point-of-lay hens selected for steady egg size, strong shells and a long, steady laying period.
intro: Each flock comes with feed phase charts, a lighting programme and a vaccination schedule, whether you run cages, deep litter or free range.

facts.label: Housing
facts.value: Cage, deep litter or free range

lists.heading: What we offer
items: Layer feed blends, calcium supplements and vitamin packs.
Nest and perch layouts sized to your flock.
Egg collection routines that cut breakages and contamination.
Lighting programmes for open-sided and closed houses.

lists.heading: Keeping production steady
items: Tracking of laying rate and egg weight.
Vet diagnosis for coccidiosis, infectious bronchitis and other layer diseases.
Flock sizing matched to local egg demand.

name: Guinea fowl, turkeys and ducks
title: Guinea fowl, turkeys and ducks
description: Guinea fowl keets, broad-breasted turkeys and Pekin and Muscovy ducks from Masvingo for hotels, restaurants and festive-season orders.
summary: Birds for festive orders, hotels and restaurants.
alt: A group of helmeted guinea fowl foraging on short grass.
lede: Hardy birds for hotels, restaurants and festive-season orders.
intro: Every order comes with biosecurity advice, a nutrition guide and a vaccination plan that works for mixed-species setups.

facts.label: Turkeys
facts.value: Broad-breasted white and bronze, poults or growers

groups.name: Guinea fowl
groups.text: Hardy birds with lean meat that settle quickly into free range. You get housing designs that limit flight, a high-protein starter feed plan and advice on keeping predators out.

groups.name: Turkeys
groups.text: Poults or growers, with a feeding schedule timed for festive-season orders. Vaccination covers fowl pox and Newcastle disease.

groups.name: Ducks
groups.text: Pekin for fast-growing meat birds, Muscovy for hardiness and lean meat. We advise on pond or trough water, litter and breeding so production keeps going all year.

lists.heading: Help with selling
items: Cold chain and slaughter guides for seasonal turkey sales.
Packaging guidance for premium markets.
Contract farming with hotels and retailers.

name: Rabbits
title: Rabbits: breeding trios and grow-out stock
description: New Zealand White, California and Chinchilla rabbits from Masvingo as breeding trios or grow-out stock, with housing designs, breeding calendars and feed plans.
summary: Breeding trios and grow-out stock, with breeding calendars.
alt: A brown rabbit sitting on straw in a wooden hutch.
lede: Fast-breeding meat rabbits that do well on local forage, for backyard projects through to commercial units.
intro: We supply breeding trios and grow-out stock, and help you choose a housing system that fits your space and budget. A trio is one buck and two does.

lists.heading: What comes with your rabbits
items: Housing designs for battery, hutch and deep litter systems.
Breeding calendars, kindling management and record sheets.
Feed plans built on local forage and pellets.

lists.heading: Selling your rabbits
lists.text: We connect farmers with butcheries, restaurants and other buyers looking for rabbit meat, and help with grading, cold chain planning and contracts for repeat orders.

name: Goats
title: Goats: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona
description: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona goats from Masvingo for meat and breeding, with pasture rotation guides, health protocols and kid nutrition plans.
summary: Boer, Kalahari Red and Mashona goats for meat and breeding.
alt: Goats with brown heads and white bodies in a pen, one looking over the log rail.
lede: Hardy meat and breeding goats suited to Zimbabwean grazing, for semi-intensive and free-range systems.
intro: We help you select a breeding herd and plan housing, grazing and cash flow for the years it takes to build it. Tell us how many does and bucks you want, or describe your current herd and we’ll suggest a mix.

lists.heading: What comes with your goats
items: Housing designs with pasture rotation guides.
Health protocols for deworming, dipping and vaccination.
Breeding herd selection and kid nutrition plans.

lists.heading: Selling your goats
lists.text: We introduce farmers to butcheries, restaurants and export buyers, and help with carcass standards, cold chain planning and contracts for repeat orders.
